If sentiment is negative (≤0.0) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to align with downward momentum.

If sentiment is positive (≥0.67) and forecast peaks > 20% above recent high, cap forecast at 10% below recent high for mid horizon (8–15 days) to avoid over-optimism.

If sentiment is neutral (0.33–0.67) and forecast shows sustained upward trend, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% per day for late horizon (16–30 days) to reflect diminishing momentum.

If sentiment is negative and forecast is below 70.0, add 0.5–1.0% correction to forecast for early horizon to avoid underestimating downside risk.

If sentiment is positive and forecast is above 75.0, reduce forecast by 1.0–1.5% for mid horizon to prevent overcorrection from bullish sentiment.

If sentiment is neutral and forecast is flat or declining, add 0.3–0.7% upward adjustment for late horizon to counteract lagging sentiment effects.
